_comment: The code that produced the committed LFM2.5 rows, captured as git BLOB hashes.
Persisted rather than derived at render time: a provenance line computed from
HEAD names whatever is checked out now, not what measured the rows, so the first
commit that touches the harness silently reattributes every row to code that
never ran. That is not a stale number, it is a false one -- the same shape as
every other 'gate decoupled from what it checks' bug in this repo.
A blob hash changes only when file CONTENT changes, which is the property wanted.
Verified: git log over both paths, restricted to the measurement window below,
is EMPTY -- no harness change landed mid-sweep, so these apply to every row.
Generated by tmp/write_provenance.py from git; hashes are never typed by hand.
